description: This file implements a media playback controller using Android's Stagefright framework, handling media extraction, decoding, and rendering, with support for surface rendering and audio decoding.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Handles media decoding and rendering, manages media extraction, codec setup, buffer processing, and responds to control messages such as start, stop, and seek.

methods.name: startAsync
methods.description: Posts a message to start media processing asynchronously.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages for starting, stopping, seeking, and codec notifications, managing media pipeline accordingly.

methods.name: makeFormat
methods.description: Creates an AMessage describing the media format, including codec-specific data, for codec setup.

methods.name: onFillThisBuffer
methods.description: Fills an output buffer with media data read from the source, handling CSD buffers and media extraction.

methods.name: onDrainThisBuffer
methods.description: Handles the event when a buffer has been drained, updating total bytes received and optionally rendering.
